visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit subway corridor with white tiled walls and advertising posters. A middle-aged woman with dark hair and a beige trench coat speaks directly to the camera while walking. A younger woman in a black top follows behind, smiling and carrying a tote bag. (2) Transitioning to a metro platform, the younger woman walks toward the camera under arched white ceilings with industrial lighting. The tracks and station signage are visible in the background. She wears sunglasses on her head and appears relaxed as she moves through the underground environment. (3) The scene cuts to a close-up of green and white subway train doors closing firmly. The train then accelerates away from the camera on the tracks. Later, we see two large pizzas topped with cheese, olives, and basil leaves resting on a table at an outdoor cafe. (4) In front of the iconic glass Louvre pyramid under a clear blue sky, the two women pose and smile. The area is filled with other tourists sitting on low walls. The lighting is bright natural daylight, creating a vibrant and energetic atmosphere for their sightseeing. (5) Inside a grand museum hall with high glass ceilings and ornate pillars, a dense crowd of people moves through the galleries. Many individuals are seen holding up smartphones and cameras to photograph the Mona Lisa, which is displayed on a dark grey wall in the distance. (6) The younger woman is shown standing outside an Apple store with a pouting expression, followed by a shot of her inside the store talking to a bearded staff member in a blue shirt. They are surrounded by displays of colorful smartphone cases on a wooden wall. (7) Walking up a flight of stone stairs in a metro station, the two women are seen laughing and talking animatedly. The lighting shifts to night artificial light as they reach the street level. A metal bridge structure is visible above them, and the atmosphere is jovial. (8) In a domestic kitchen setting, a person's hands are shown using a wooden-handled knife to chop white mushrooms and raw meat on a white cutting board. The lighting is warm and domestic. A bottle of white foam soap is used to wash hands under a metal faucet. (9) The final shots show food being cooked in pans on a stove. On top, sliced meat and onions sizzle in oil, while the bottom frame shows a pot of bubbling chicken and mushroom porridge being stirred with a spoon. The scene conveys a cozy, home-cooked meal.
